headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 17, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory behind Jesús Luzardo's strong performance. In other action, the Washington Nationals took down the Kansas City Royals in a thrilling 6-4 victory, while the Toronto Blue Jays cruised past the Boston Red Sox 6-1.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with notable players such as Gleyber Torres (Detroit Tigers) and Will Wilson (Seattle Mariners) landing on the injured list. Torres is out with a left oblique strain, while Wilson suffers from a left thumb fracture.

Several teams made roster moves, including the Kansas City Royals trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, while the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Rout Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies' offense with a strong performance, earning the win with 7.0 innings pitched, 9 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a hard-fought win against the Kansas City Royals, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland notching the save. Curtis Mead led the Royals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with George Springer leading the offense. Springer hit a home run (7) on a line drive to left center field, scoring Myles Straw.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a 7th home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds in a one-sided matchup, securing a 9-1 victory. The Mets' strong performance was led by key contributions from Jorge Polanco and Christian Scott.

top_news.title: **Gleyber Torres Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers second baseman Gleyber Torres has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain, effective retroactive to June 16, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
